tasks.short: Apply for tariff concessions and duty drawbacks

steps.what: Open tariff concessions and prior refunds
Draft duty drawbacks from the stored figures

loop.purpose: Draft a concession or drawback application only from stored duty figures.
loop.input: Entry id and the stored duty figures.
loop.output: A draft application, or a stop.
loop.check: The figures in the draft equal the stored duty figures.
loop.stop: Stop when a required figure is missing.
loop.why_not_simpler: An application that invents a refund amount cannot be filed.

steps.what: Apply for concessions the draft cannot fill
File the application the broker signed

tasks.design: Prior concessions and refunds are opened from {GOV_PORTAL}. A drawback draft uses only stored duty figures in {DOCS}. The broker applies for anything the draft cannot fill, and signs before the application is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: The application was rebuilt from old refund files and a calculator.
tasks.enabler_now: The duty figures and any earlier refund are stored on the entry, so the draft can cite them.
tasks.still_hard: Whether the concession applies, and a figure the entry does not hold, stay with the broker.

ambition.what: An entry with stored figures gets a draft the day the refund is asked, and the broker still signs it.

tasks.altitude: The broker sees the figures beside the draft.

reach.task: Confirm the refund should be asked

evidence.claim: A drawback draft cites stored figures, and the broker signs the application. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a concession or a drawback is to be applied for and ends when the broker has signed the application.
The entry has entry id, duty paid, and any prior refund id, produced by the filing record. A missing figure stops the draft.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How often the authority asks for evidence that is not on the entry.
research_questions: Which applications stopped because a figure was missing?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: application the broker signed for that concession

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving counts entries whose duty figures are stored. A missing figure is filled by the broker, and the signature stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Contract with freight forwarders for destination services

steps.what: Open destination services still needing a forwarder
Contract with freight forwarders for those services
Note destination services the contract left out

tasks.design: Destination services still open are listed from {ERP}. The broker contracts with the freight forwarder by {TELEPHONY}, and the contract is held in {CLM}. Services the contract does not cover stay listed. The system does not agree a price.
tasks.previous_blocker: The forwarder was called from memory, and the services were restated each time.
tasks.enabler_now: The open services are on the shipment, so the conversation starts from that list.
tasks.still_hard: The price and the forwarder's capacity are still agreed by the broker.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the destination services before contracting a forwarder.

evidence.claim: The service list can be opened, and the contract is made by the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when destination services need a forwarder and ends when the broker has made the contract or noted the gap.
A service row has shipment id, place, and service type, produced by the order. A row with no place is not put in a contract by the system.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the forwarder will accept terms that start from the service list.
research_questions: Which destination services are still without a contract?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

approvals.approved_version: contract the broker is making with that forwarder

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening a service list that already exists. Bargaining and the contract stay with the broker.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor or trace the location of goods

steps.what: Monitor location events for the goods
Trace goods whose location events have stopped
Note goods the trace could not place

tasks.design: Location events are monitored on a {OPS_SYSTEM} board from the carrier's status messages. The broker traces goods whose events have stopped, by the board and by {TELEPHONY}. Goods the trace cannot place stay listed. A silent carrier is not given a guessed place.
tasks.previous_blocker: Location was asked by phone because the last message was in a mailbox.
tasks.enabler_now: Status messages can be shown against the shipment, so a stop is visible without a call.
tasks.still_hard: A carrier who has gone quiet still has to be traced by the broker.
tasks.human_edge: The broker decides which goods are still unplaced.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees which goods have stopped reporting before starting a trace.

evidence.claim: A status board can show events that already arrived, and the trace of a gap stays with the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when goods are in transit and ends when the broker has traced a stop or noted that the place is unknown.
An event has shipment id, place, and time, produced by the carrier. A shipment with no event is not given a place by the board.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: How complete the carrier's status messages are.
research_questions: Which goods have had no event since the last expected time?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is watching events that the carrier already sends. A gap is traced by the broker, and an unknown place stays unknown.

steps.what: Open labeling rules for the products
Suggest packaging methods for the products
Note methods the labeling rules did not cover

tasks.design: Stored labeling rules for the product are opened from {DOCS}. The broker suggests packaging methods to the client. A method the rules do not cover is noted, not invented as a rule. The suggestion is the broker's.
tasks.previous_blocker: The suggestion was given from memory, and the label rule was checked afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: The rules are stored against the product, so the broker sees them before suggesting a method.
tasks.still_hard: The best method for this product and this route is still the broker's judgement.
tasks.altitude: The broker sees the labeling rules before suggesting a method.

evidence.claim: Label rules can be opened, and the packaging suggestion stays with the broker. The source pack says duty and tax figures are configured from a public tariff and contracted rates, and that a classification is taken from a stored binding decision only when one matches, with the broker signing the code.

The source pack says a solely automated decision with a significant effect on a person needs a human review. A duty figure here is a stored rate times a stored value, and the broker signs before a filing, a payment, or a quote leaves. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when a product needs a packaging or labeling suggestion and ends when the broker has made the suggestion.
A rule has product id, label text, and market, maintained by the broker. A product with no rule is suggested without a cited rule.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the broker's effort.
A missing rate, code, or document is not invented. The broker does that part.
The incremental hour updates the record when its source row changes.
unknowns: Whether the client's packer can follow a rule that is only stored as text.
research_questions: Which products have no stored labeling rule?

already_counted.description: The checking time is already in the broker's step.

incremental.description: Update the opened record when its source row changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The saving is opening rules that are already stored. The suggestion itself stays with the broker.

role.altitude: Concessions are drafted from stored figures and signed by the broker. Forwarder contracts are made in person. Location gaps are traced by the broker. Packaging advice stays with the broker.
reach: A client sees which entry a refund cites.
A carrier sees which goods have stopped reporting.
skills_to_grow: Do not invent a refund figure.
Do not give a place to goods that have gone quiet.
